checksums.name: header_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: FUN_08054f18: s=(s+(u8)buf[i]) mod 65536 for i in [0,0x18); stored u16_le at header+0 with field zeroed before recompute (FUN_08054f6c: *hdr=0; *hdr=sum16(hdr,0x18)). Stored field is little-endian in file.

checksums.name: slot_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: FUN_08054f44(slot_index,slot_ptr): stored_u16le[header+2+index*2]=FUN_08054f18(slot_ptr,0xF60)=sum of all 3936 slot bytes mod 65536. Verified separately for all 4 slots in both files.

io_driver_functions.notes: sum16 of unsigned bytes, length masked to u16. Textual call-site mapping; see report.
Computes slot sum16 (0xF60) and stores at header+2+index*2.
Zeroes header+0 then stores sum16(header,0x18). Callers via func_ thunk in 0x08054d74 (callgraph lists only 0x08054fbc).
Initialises 24-byte header: memset 0, memcpy 4 bytes to +0x0A (A2M7), bytes +0x11/+0x12=0xFF.
Default-initialises one 0xF60 slot: index at +0x10, 0x640 at +0x0C, WAFFY at +0x5A0, bitfield at +0xF0C, 0xFF stride-4 array near +0xF4F.
Verify header: compares 4 bytes at +0x0A against expected (A2M7) and recomputes header sum16.
Load+validate whole save from flash offset 0; on any failure calls 0x08054fbc reset.
Blank-reset: init header+4 slots, recompute all checksums, flush whole buffer via 0x08058cd4.
Header-only flush: 0x08054f6c then 0x08058cd4(header,0,0x18). No textual/callgraph caller found; entry via unrecovered jumptable/function pointer.
Boot save init: default-init slot buffer then load/validate (0x08054e50).
Flash identify/init wrapper: calls 0x0806e18c, checks chip descriptor, sets mode via 0x0806dd74.
Sector-buffered flash read (RAM dst, flash offset, length). Allocates EWRAM sector buffer via 0x08055794.
Sector-buffered flash write, read-modify-write per sector via 0x08058e0c/0x08058e68.
Load one flash sector into buffer: 0x0806df04 then up to 3x 0x0806e068.
Flush sector buffer to flash via 0x0806e100, retry once on failure.
Flash ID read: 0xAA/0x55/0x90 unlock at 0x0E000000 window, byte reads via 0x0806e610 stub, 0xF0 reset. Returns (id1<<8)|id2.
IdentifyFlash/SetFlash: match ID (entry+0x28) in chip table, install descriptor (size/sector shift).
EraseFlashSector: sector<16, 0xAA/0x55/0x80/0xAA/0x55/0x30 sequence + wait via 0x0806e608 stub. No traced caller.
ProgramFlashByte: 0xAA/0x55/0xA0 unlock then single byte program + wait/verify stub. No traced caller.
Flash sector core A (bank switch if chip size 0x20000); core loop in unrecovered 0x0806e608 stub.
Flash sector core B called in 3x retry loop by 0x08058e0c; exact read/program split inside stub unresolved.
ProgramFlashSector core passed RAM buffer + flash address in 0x0E000000 window.
Program sector wrapper: verify stub 0x0806e604 then 0x0806dfd0, up to 3 attempts.
Copies relocatable flash-polling stub to stack/RAM before touching flash.
memcpy (word+byte tail).
memset (byte replicated to word). Also many non-save callers.
Set bit (1<<(i&7)) in byte at ptr+(i>>3). Used 20x to build slot bitfield at +0xF0C.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Change 'A' of A2M7 to 'X', then repair header sum16 at +0
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Isolates magic check: even with valid checksum, 0x08054ec8 magic compare fails -> blank reset/rewrite.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Change stored slot_0 checksum, then repair header sum16 at +0
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Slot_0 sum (0x08054f18 over 0xF60) != stored -> blank reset of all slots (no per-slot recovery).

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Accepted on load (all checks pass; already observed in cap-01). In-game effect of +0x13 unknown - candidate global value/counter; monitor UI/RAM for change vs 0x00 control.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If name field is displayed (pet/Sim name), renamed string appears where WAFFY was shown; no reset if both checksums repaired.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: One of 20 default-set flags (indices 1,2,6,8-13,20-23,25,29-31,33,38,39) cleared; predicted loss of corresponding unlock/feature/state - identify by toggling single bits.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set slot_0 +0x0C u32 0x640->0x641, repair slot+header sums
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Tests semantics of constant 1600 field (currency/points/score hypothesis); watch numeric UI tied to slot.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If loader trusts index, slot ordering/identity confusion; if position wins, no effect. Distinguishes index-as-identity vs index-as-data.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Write 0x00 at 0x3D98 (first byte past active save, in 0xFF tail)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: No effect predicted: never read (load length stops at 0x3D98) and no checksum covers it. Control for fuzzing harness.

open_questions: Absolute RAM mirror address of save buffer (header base) is unresolved: every _DAT_080xxxxx literal in decompiled.c lacks its value, so ram_addr is null throughout. Slot RAM base is referenced as _DAT_08055010 with header at slot0-0x18.
Semantics of header byte +0x13 (0x00 in cap-00, 0xAB in cap-01): only observed mutation besides checksums; writer and gameplay meaning unknown. Not a simple +1 counter (delta +0xAB).

Upstream caller/trigger of header-only flush FUN_08054d74 and of any gameplay slot writer: no textual or callgraph caller exists; entry is via unrecovered jumptable/function pointer, and no slot-sized (0xF60) flash write call site exists in the traced corpus besides full reset.

Exact core loops of AgbFlash stubs FUN_0806e604/0806e608/0806e610 and chip sector size/shift (descriptor fields at +4/+8) are in unrecovered jumptables; read/program/verify split between FUN_0806df04 and FUN_0806e068 is inferred from call context only.

Length arguments passed via unresolved _DAT literals in FUN_08054e50 read, FUN_08054fbc write and FUN_08054e50 slot-check (uRam08054ec0) are inferred as 0x3D98/0xF60 from sav geometry and FUN_08054f44, not read from literals.

Most slot payload bytes (0x14-0x59F, 0x5A5-0xF0B, 0xF11-0xF4E, 0xF5F-0xF5F tail) are zero in both near-blank samples and have no traced writer besides memset/default loops with unresolved offsets; their field semantics are UNKNOWN.
No paired .ss save states are present (states/ is empty), so fuzzing plan must use cold .sav reload in an emulator rather than state-paired reload.
